profile.name: Reajul Islam Robin
profile.focus: Full-Stack Engineering · Healthcare · Fintech · Distributed Systems
profile.headline: I build secure, scalable systems across fintech and healthcare — from clinical microservices to payment infrastructure.
profile.summary: Full-stack engineer with 3 years building secure, scalable systems using Angular, TypeScript, C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, backed by PostgreSQL/SQL Server and hands-on Docker/Kubernetes deployment experience. Delivered microservices for clinical workflows — prescriptions, appointments, and telemedicine — including real-time scheduling logic and secure video sessions, backed by xUnit test coverage. Skilled in Domain-Driven Design, RESTful API design, EF Core, and event-driven architecture (Kafka/RabbitMQ), with a track record of measurable performance and workflow improvements in regulated, data-sensitive environments (fintech PCI-DSS, healthcare).
profile.education: B.Sc.(Engg.) Computer Science & Engineering · Mawlana Bhashani Science & Technology University (2017–2021)

experience.summary: Led development of the Appointment and Telemedicine services within a larger clinical/healthcare microservices platform spanning Payment, Prescription, User-Management, Content-Management, and other domains.
achievements: Led development of the Appointment and Telemedicine services within a larger clinical/healthcare microservices platform built with .NET 8, Clean Architecture, and CQRS/MediatR, backed by PostgreSQL/EF Core, with xUnit unit and integration tests covering booking and payment logic.

Secured services with Keycloak-based OAuth 2.0/OIDC authentication and role-based access control (RBAC), applied PHI masking in logs and API responses, and implemented audit logging of sensitive patient-record access, with secrets managed via Azure Key Vault.

Designed the appointment scheduling and booking domain with a slot-hold lifecycle supporting multiple convergent release mechanisms, and resolved race conditions in concurrent booking flows with real-time updates via WebSockets/SSE.

Integrated SSLCommerz for payments with platform-aware redirects, and implemented per-participant Agora token minting for secure, access-controlled telemedicine video sessions handling sensitive patient interactions.

Containerized and deployed all microservices with Docker, orchestrating hands-on production deployments on Docker Swarm and K3s (Kubernetes) with GitLab CI/CD, and operated the platform's distributed messaging infrastructure (Kafka, RabbitMQ) with Serilog/Graylog centralized logging and Zipkin distributed tracing, including diagnosing a critical disk-space incident traced to Kafka's storage volume.

experience.summary: Built secure, high-throughput ASP.NET Core Web APIs on Microsoft SQL Server for ConnexPay, a mission-critical fintech platform, aligned with PCI-DSS standards.
achievements: Built secure, high-throughput ASP.NET Core Web APIs on Microsoft SQL Server for ConnexPay, a mission-critical fintech platform, aligned with PCI-DSS standards (a regulated-data compliance model closely paralleling HIPAA/PHI handling), securing endpoints with Microsoft Identity authentication and role-based authorization, with robust exception handling.
Integrated third-party payment gateways including Visa, TSYS, and BlueSnap, implementing webhook/IPN handling, transaction validation, and ledger updates.

Applied Domain-Driven Design and layered service abstractions with Repository and Unit of Work patterns, optimizing query performance and helping modularize the monolith toward a microservices-ready architecture.
Automated the client onboarding workflow by redesigning backend processes and database schema, cutting setup time by 30%.
Built Node.js/Express backend services and REST APIs for in-house MERN-stack applications, applying event-driven, asynchronous design patterns for concurrent, I/O-heavy workloads.

projects.name: The Algomist - DSA Journey
projects.description: A personal DSA preparation tool focused on organizing data structures and algorithms practice into a structured learning routine, with AI-generated topic breakdowns via Grok AI.
highlights: Developed a personal DSA preparation tool that organizes practice into a structured learning routine.
Features AI-generated topic breakdowns via Grok AI.
Includes difficulty progression and progress tracking.

projects.name: mypaw - Pet Healthcare Platform
projects.description: A modular monolith pet healthcare platform built with .NET 8 and Angular, using PostgreSQL with pgvector for semantic search and a RAG triage module for symptom-based recommendations.
highlights: Architected a modular monolith pet healthcare platform with .NET 8 and Angular, using PostgreSQL with pgvector for semantic search.
Migrated the monorepo from Docker Compose to Kubernetes, hand-writing deployment manifests and adding CI/CD pipelines and observability with Serilog, Graylog, and Zipkin.
Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) triage module combining Ollama embeddings and the Gemini API for symptom-based recommendations.

projects.name: SNOMED CT Clinical Search API
projects.description: A clinical terminology search API exposing lexical and semantic autocomplete endpoints over the SNOMED CT dataset, with sub-second lookup using tsvector and pgvector.
highlights: Built a clinical terminology search API exposing lexical and semantic autocomplete endpoints over the SNOMED CT dataset.
Designed a denormalized search table with generated tsvector columns and word-similarity matching for fast, accurate lexical search.
Delivered sub-second semantic concept lookup using pgvector embeddings alongside the lexical search path.
